2010:
This article is a '''list of [[Hot Wheels]]''' released in '''2010'''.

The 2010 Mainline (US) consists of 240 cars total: 44 [[2010 New Models|New Models]], 12 [[2010 Treasure Hunts Series|Treasure Hunts]], 12 [[Track Stars Series (2010)|Track Stars]], 48 Race World Series of 4 cars each, and the Race World (New in 2010) which are [[Race_World -_Volcano_Series_(2010)|Race World - Volcano]], [[Race World - City_Series_(2010)|Race World - City]] and 9 [[Segment Series]] of 10 cars each. The Segment Series in 2010 are [[HW Garage|HW Garage]], [[Muscle Mania Series (2010)|Muscle Mania]], [[Nightburnerz Series (2010)|Nightburnerz]], [[HW Performance Series (2010)|HW Performance]], [[HW_City_Works_Series (2010)|HW City Works]], [[All Stars Series (2010)|All Stars]], [[Faster Than Ever Series (2010)|Faster Than Ever]], [[HW Hot Rods Series (2010)|HW Hot Rods]], [[HW Racing Series (2010)|HW Racing]] and [[Hot Auction Series (2010)|Hot Auction]]. The [[Mystery Car Series (2010)|Mystery Car Series]] are also back with 24 cars.
